## Dream Cycle Research — 2026-04-14

### New Papers Integrated

**arXiv:2602.07048 — LLM Semantic Filtering for Lead-Lag Trading (Kim et al., Feb 2026)**
- Architecture: Granger causality top-100 → LLM re-rank → trade top-20 pairs
- LLM output: plausibility_score (0-100) + mechanism_strength + co_movement_sign (JSON)
- Primary effect: LOSS REDUCTION not win rate (avg loss -46.5%, total PnL +205%)
- LLM model: GPT-5-nano; robust across GPT-5-mini too
- Best hold period: 1d (WR 66.7% hybrid)
- DIRECT APPLICATION: R29 pairs trading LLM filter — switch from hard threshold to ranking, add sign prediction

**arXiv:2510.11616 — Attention Factors for Statistical Arbitrage (Stanford, ACM ICAIF 2025)**
- Joint optimization: attention factors + residual portfolio + LongConv signal → net-of-cost Sharpe
- Net SR: 2.28 (attention) vs 1.57 (PCA) vs -6.45 (OU threshold)
- Critical: OU-thresholding collapses after transaction costs (gross SR 0.18 → net SR -6.45)
- Past returns chars dominate value/profitability for stat arb (-62% SR if removed)
- Partial adoption: optimize OU thresholds against net-of-cost Sharpe on validation set
- Full adoption: R35 research round (requires PyTorch + firm characteristic data)

**arXiv:2603.20247 — AlphaLogics: Market Logic-Driven Multi-Agent Alpha Factor Generation (March 2026)**
- 3-stage: extract market logic from existing factors → generate new factors → refine via backtesting
- CSI 500 IR=1.53, S&P 500 IR=1.27; 92-100% logic consistency
- Relevant for future factor mining rounds — start by extracting logic from 146-strategy harness

**arXiv:2603.21330 — FinRL-X with 6-month live paper trading validation (March 2026)**
- Alpaca paper trading Oct 2025-Mar 2026: +19.76% vs SPY -2.51%, Sharpe 1.96
- Weight-centric unified interface across selection/allocation/timing/risk
- Worth monitoring; rare credible live RL deployment result
